basic_info.description: Rarely available garden level oasis at The Palms. Full amenity building includes security, concierge service, 24-hour lobby attendant, theater, owner's lounge, yoga studio and fitness center. Large floor to ceiling bedroom windows and living room overlooking the serene greenery of the courtyard. Fresh paint, designer lighting fixtures and storage galore! Perfectly located mere blocks from the waterfront, restaurants, bars, Oracle Park, CalTrain, Whole Foods, shopping, freeway, & more. 4th Street MUNI line outside the front door with direct access to North Beach!
